text.en:
Currency Act
(CHAPTER 69)
Currency (Denominations and Characteristics of Coins) (No. 3)
Notification 2011
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 12th November 2011 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
DESCRIPTION OF THE 2011 NATIVE ORCHIDS OF SINGAPORE COINS TO BE ISSUED ON 12TH NOVEMBER 2011

The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date "2011" below it and the word "SINGAPORE" in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coin. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o'clock of the coin.
The coin design features the orchid “Grammatophyllum speciosum” in full colour at the centre with its name along the upper circumference. The denomination is at the left of the coin, while the weight and fineness of the coin are around the lower left circumference.
